name: Playwright, Selenium, Cypress
note: Questions authored by Claude as practice material. Not sourced from your own notes or any official exam. Verify anything you doubt against the docs.

options: Waits for elements to be actionable before acting
questions.why: Actions wait for visible, enabled, stable elements.

questions.q: Which Playwright locator style is generally recommended first?
questions.why: Role and text locators survive markup changes better.

questions.q: In Selenium, which is better than time.sleep() for waiting?
questions.why: Explicit waits poll for a condition.

questions.q: Which command records actions into Playwright test code?
questions.why: codegen opens a recorder that outputs test code.

questions.q: How does Playwright keep tests isolated from each other?
options: A new browser context per test
questions.why: Each test gets a fresh context, with its own storage.
